    Age 2 yrs+ require a ticket for entry A WEST COAST PREMIERE Wendy MacLeod's comedy, The Laugh Track, takes us behind the scenes of I Love Lucy. Based on the real-life experiences of Hollywood's first female TV writer, Madelyn Pugh, this play shines light on the inner workings of America's beloved sitcom and the woman who punched up the jokes, fought for her career, and paved the way for women in the writers room. Fast-paced and full of wit, The Laugh Track brings familiar characters to life, while proving that comedy is not a man's job.

    Miel San Marcos Conference 2026

    9:00 AM · Terrace Theater - Long Beach Convention and Entertainment Center, Long Beach

    Guatemalan worship band Miel San Marcos will hold its Miel San Marcos Conference 2026, titled "El Lugar Más Alto," at the Terrace Theater in downtown Long Beach on Friday, Nov. 6 and Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026. The two-day gathering brings a Spanish-language act with 3 million monthly Spotify listeners and 2.8 million YouTube subscribers into the region with the largest concentration of Guatemalan Americans in the country, drawing a national-scale audience for a full weekend rather than a single night. Miel San Marcos formed in 1998 when three brothers, Josh, Luis and Samy Morales, began leading worship at their church in San Marcos, Guatemala. Nearly every album the band has released was recorded live in front of a congregation. The group has won Dove Awards and Arpa Awards and earned a nomination at the Latin Grammy Awards.

    Chris Dave X Eric Gales X MonoNeon X Cory Henry

    7:00 PM · Blue Note Los Angeles, Hollywood · $18.80 Algo especial

    Four visionary forces in modern music collide as Chris Dave, Eric Gales, MonoNeon and Cory Henry unite for an explosive, one-of-a-kind quartet experience. Chris Dave's groundbreaking rhythms, Eric Gales' electrifying guitar work, MonoNeon's unmistakable bass grooves, and Cory Henry's extraordinary keyboard mastery come together in a fearless fusion of funk, blues, rock, jazz, and experimental sound. Each artist is a musical powerhouse in their own right, celebrated for pushing boundaries and redefining what's possible on their respective instruments. Together, they create an unpredictable sonic universe where deep grooves, raw energy, and fearless improvisation take center stage. Expect an electrifying night of extraordinary musical chemistry, spontaneous interplay, and virtuosic performances that defy genre and convention. With four master musicians sharing one stage, no two moments will ever be alike. More than a concert, this is a rare meeting of creative minds, a celebration of rhythm and raw expression, and an opportunity to witness four innovators redefining what a modern power quartet can be.     ICT: The Laugh Track

    7:30 PM · Beverly O'Neill - Long Beach Convention and Entertainment Center, Long Beach Para salir

    Age 2 yrs+ require a ticket for entry A WEST COAST PREMIERE Wendy MacLeod's comedy, The Laugh Track, takes us behind the scenes of I Love Lucy. Based on the real-life experiences of Hollywood's first female TV writer, Madelyn Pugh, this play shines light on the inner workings of America's beloved sitcom and the woman who punched up the jokes, fought for her career, and paved the way for women in the writers room. Fast-paced and full of wit, The Laugh Track brings familiar characters to life, while proving that comedy is not a man's job.

    Age 2 yrs+ require a ticket for entry A WEST COAST PREMIERE Wendy MacLeod's comedy, The Laugh Track, takes us behind the scenes of I Love Lucy. Based on the real-life experiences of Hollywood's first female TV writer, Madelyn Pugh, this play shines light on the inner workings of America's beloved sitcom and the woman who punched up the jokes, fought for her career, and paved the way for women in the writers room. Fast-paced and full of wit, The Laugh Track brings familiar characters to life, while proving that comedy is not a man's job.

    Ebony Loren with REBBY

    6:30 PM · The Moroccan Lounge, Downtown Algo especial

    The Moroccan Lounge Presents: Ebony Loren with REBBY [November 8, 2026 / Doors 6:30pm / $20 adv / $25 dos / All Ages] Ebony Loren is a 25-year-old singer-songwriter originally from Milwaukee, Wisconsin, currently based in Los Angeles. She has been releasing music since 2020, developing a sound rooted in acoustic pop with influences in R&B and jazz. In November 2025, she released her debut album, Work in Progress, a reflection of navigating her twenties, self-discovery, and the growing pains of adulthood. The album explores themes of nostalgia, imposter syndrome, overwhelm of busy adult life, and acknowledging your flaws while still finding self-love. Having built her fanbase organically, and largely independently, Ebony takes pride in creating music that feels personal, with a focus on connecting with listeners and making them feel seen.
